package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// TaskLearningTargetRepoPG persists task-to-curriculum target references.
type TaskLearningTargetRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (repositoryPG TaskLearningTargetRepoPG) ListByTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) ([]domain.TaskLearningTarget, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, repositoryPG.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT task_id, target_type, target_key, target_version, "order"
FROM task_learning_target
WHERE task_id = $1
ORDER BY "order", target_type, target_key, target_version
`, taskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := make([]domain.TaskLearningTarget, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var target domain.TaskLearningTarget
		if err := rows.Scan(&target.TaskID, &target.Type, &target.Key, &target.Version, &target.Order); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, target)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func (repositoryPG TaskLearningTargetRepoPG) ReplaceForTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string, targets []domain.TaskLearningTarget) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, repositoryPG.Pool)
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM task_learning_target WHERE task_id = $1`, taskID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, target := range targets {
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO task_learning_target (task_id, target_type, target_key, target_version, "order")
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
`, taskID, target.Type, target.Key, target.Version, target.Order); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

var _ repository.TaskLearningTargetRepository = (*TaskLearningTargetRepoPG)(nil)
